source.phase_pointer: M3.4 structural determinism S0 through S5

phase.goal: Make deterministic simulation compilation and binary consumption mechanically auditable without changing authoritative behavior
out_of_scope: Authoritative simulation behavior or replay encoding changes
phase.done_condition: Exact-head CI is green after game and test paths reproduce oracle 0x637628abff59c823 through one eng_sim artifact and all isolation checks pass

tasks.goal: Record the untouched M3.3 build matrix oracle logic hash and dependency seams
tasks.context: M3.4 must detect any behavior change against merged main before build policy changes
tasks.output_contract: The slate names the exact baseline commit and observed Debug RelWithDebInfo Release oracle hash and dependency evidence
tasks.done_check: All three warning-as-error configurations pass 28 CTest entries and the controlled mutation reports tick 4321 position_x entity 7

failure_states.trigger: Any untouched configuration oracle or boundary check fails
expected_evidence: Failing command and first diagnostic are recorded

verification_handoff.method: Re-run the exact matrix and focused deterministic executable from clean main
expected_evidence: Debug RelWithDebInfo and Release each report 28 of 28 tests passed
Boundary scripts name the intended module seams

tasks.goal: Give every eng_sim source one named deterministic compiler policy
tasks.context: Target-local fp flags are easy to drift and cannot be audited from one owner
inputs: Existing EngineOptions and eng_sim target definitions
tasks.output_contract: A named CMake policy owns deterministic flags and an automated test rejects missing duplicate or contradictory sim flags

output_artifacts.description: Central deterministic compiler policy and drift check

tasks.done_check: Generated compile commands show the named policy on every eng_sim translation unit in every MSVC configuration and the drift test passes

failure_states.trigger: Any eng_sim translation unit lacks the deterministic policy or receives a conflicting fp option
expected_evidence: Drift check names the affected source and option

verification_handoff.method: Inspect generated compile invocations and deliberately test the policy checker against a contradictory fixture
expected_evidence: Every eng_sim source receives one accepted floating-point policy
Contradictory fixture fails closed

tasks.goal: Prove runnable and test paths consume the same eng_sim artifact and hash stream
tasks.context: Behavioral parity must cover the executable path without recompiling simulation sources
tasks.output_contract: A headless runnable mode and the dedicated test path replay identical commands through the same linked eng_sim library and report the pinned oracle
tasks.done_check: CTest compares runnable and test outputs and both report 0x637628abff59c823 without any executable compiling engine/sim sources

failure_states.trigger: Runnable and test paths report different per-tick hashes or final oracle values
expected_evidence: First differing tick and both hashes are recorded

verification_handoff.method: Run both executables from a clean build and inspect link and source ownership
expected_evidence: Both executables report the pinned final oracle
Only eng_sim compiles engine/sim implementation sources

tasks.goal: Reject source include link and accidental recompilation violations around eng_sim
tasks.context: The mature deterministic island needs checks over generated build evidence as well as source text
inputs: Existing sim and presentation boundary checks
tasks.output_contract: One focused gate checks forbidden source tokens includes target links compile options and duplicate sim compilation with actionable diagnostics
tasks.done_check: All real-tree checks pass and representative forbidden dependency option include and duplicate-source fixtures fail closed

effects: Wire checks into existing local gates

failure_states.trigger: A forbidden source include link option or duplicate compilation path is found
expected_evidence: Diagnostic names the violated boundary and exact path or target

verification_handoff.method: Run real-tree and negative-fixture isolation checks from a clean configured build
expected_evidence: Real tree passes every isolation dimension
Each negative fixture produces its intended failure class

tasks.goal: Record an explicit clang-cl and UBSan capability result for the deterministic oracle
tasks.context: The second toolchain is a stretch gate and unsupported Windows sanitizer combinations must be visible
tasks.output_contract: A reproducible configure and run path either proves the oracle under clang-cl and UBSan or reports the exact unsupported capability without a false pass

output_artifacts.description: Clang-cl and UBSan capability and oracle result

tasks.done_check: The stretch script exits success only after a real oracle run or an explicit recognized unsupported capability result

failure_states.trigger: The second-toolchain path fails without matching a proven unsupported capability
expected_evidence: Compiler command and first unclassified diagnostic are recorded

verification_handoff.method: Run the stretch path in a fresh build directory and inspect its capability classification
expected_evidence: Clang-cl oracle matches or exact unavailable reason is reported
UBSan run matches or exact unsupported runtime reason is reported

tasks.goal: Close M3.4 with full local remote and independent acceptance evidence
tasks.context: Phase 4 remains blocked until the structural determinism contract is verified end to end
